known_before_protocol: Source tables and their ranges, and named source-site coordinates already inspected. Search results exposed official grid references for Fishbourne, Chedworth, Lullingstone and Rudston; external pages for all six anchors found. This is exposed schema investigation, not a preregistered independent accuracy test. No candidate model predictions loaded or scored.
rationale: Source DDL documents X_REF/Y_REF OSGB but export uses MAP suffix. Official map client3857 is not evidence of CSV CRS. Reynolds thesis Table4.6 labels MAP X as Northing and Y as Easting, contrary to an alternative X-easting interpretation; verify against independent official site references rather than silently choosing.
matching: Exact casefolded site name only, one unique source record per declared name; fail ambiguous/missing matches, no fuzzy matching or nearest-candidate selection. Extract official NGR field; fail multiple references instead of choosing closest.
comparison: Convert official two-letter British National Grid references to metric easting/northing arithmetically. Report all per-hypothesis aggregate residuals and count within1km; no offset fitting, scale tuning, dropped outliers or threshold selection after calculation. Treat independent listed point and investigated point as different point definitions; distances do not certify survey precision.
decision: Require all six named-site references within1km for an operational OSGB-compatible XY interpretation. Never declare whole-source metre accuracy, official export CRS certification or validation of the climate/settlement model. Retain map precision/physical-place/function dates/coverage as separate gates.
output: Aggregate interpretation audit, source URLs and local hashes only; raw CSV/site coordinates/HTML/PDF remain cache-only. No source target map, transformation of all records, model score, allocation, actor/control/physics change or sealed status.

research_source.finding: MAP field names reused for GIS, but axis labels reverse the X-easting/Y-northing interpretation. Source is thesis reuse, not official ADS CRS metadata.
